name: @hl-bos/barberos-cockpit
description: Herman Legacy Digital — Barbershop Transformation Cockpit. The INTERNAL operator application for the BarberOS managed service: prospect, verified audit, discovery call, recommendations, proposal, sale, onboarding, capability delivery, client CRM, retention and reporting. Adds no schema of its own — it is a UI over the existing public.barberos_* and public.barberos_audit_* RPCs, so RLS, tenancy, permissions, audit logging and the capability catalog's honesty rules remain the only authority.
